facts.fact: Bethany 梦见自己在 The Simpsons 色情模仿片中扮演 Marge Simpson；她认出镜头后的导演是 GlobalVill.com 的著名 CEO Anthony “Fisch” Fischer。
facts.anchor: He was both gentle and commanding, and though Bethany was pinned too deep into the sofa to actually see him, she knew who it was standing behind the camera. Anthony “Fisch” Fischer, the famous CEO of GlobalVill.com.

facts.fact: Bethany 醒来时是九月下旬的傍晚，Abel 尚未下班；当晚是她在 GlobalVill 的休班夜，两人按 Abel 的要求安排了约会夜。
facts.anchor: It was Bethany’s night off from GlobalVill, and at Abel’s request, the two had plans for a date night.

facts.fact: Bethany 断定这段关系需要结束——两人仍同住、同床、互称男女朋友，但在她心里这段近十年的关系已经结束。
facts.anchor: That even though the two of them still lived together, still slept in the same bed and called each other boyfriend and girlfriend, in her mind, at least, their almost decade-long relationship was already over.

facts.fact: Bethany 在最严重的一次自残事件后被父母送进自称「问题青少年医院」的基督教改造中心；她 18 岁生日后数月脱离该处并逃离 Harlingen。
facts.anchor: She’d ditched Harlingen after her eighteenth birthday, just months after being released from that place where her parents had her committed following her worst ever self-harm incident: that Christian reconditioning center which had advertised itself as a hospital for troubled youth.

facts.fact: Bethany 收拾行李、留下字条、搭上 Greyhound 离家，几周后才打电话告诉父母她还活着。
facts.anchor: She packed a bag, wrote a note, and hopped a Greyhound, only calling home several weeks later to tell her parents that she was still alive.

facts.fact: Bethany 在 GlobalVill 评论区认识跨性别女孩 Lily（正是 Lily 鼓励她逃往 Austin）；到 Austin 后她向 Lily 出柜，并把名字从 Noah 改为 Bethany。
facts.anchor: she changed her name from Noah (rest in peace) to Bethany (live forever).

facts.fact: Bethany 在 Austin 咖啡店 Cherrywood 认识 Abel；Abel 为她付了新衣橱、激光脱毛、电解与 FFS 的费用，从不要求回报。
facts.anchor: He paid for her new wardrobe, for laser hair removal, then electrolysis and FFS.

facts.fact: 约会夜 Bethany 发短信说当晚和 Lily 聚会、明天下班后回；Abel 回复 “No worries. I understand”，一秒后又发来三个脸红爱心表情。
facts.anchor: “No worries. I understand,” Abel texted. A second later, he sent three blushing heart emojis.
